summary: First iteration backend-only testing of TebaHouse FastAPI. All 16 pytest test cases passed (100%). Covered auth (login success/fail, /me with/without token, bad token), beats (public list, create with multipart upload, static file fetch, delete auth/persistence/404 on re-delete, non-image rejection), and contact (create valid/invalid email/empty message/empty name, list unauthorized/as admin). Verified /api/uploads static file routing through Kubernetes ingress works for both cover images and audio.

minor.issue: File uploads are written synchronously (shutil.copyfileobj) inside an async handler; could block the event loop for large files. Consider run_in_executor or aiofiles.
No file size limit or allowed extension whitelist; only content-type prefix is checked (easily spoofed by client). Consider size cap + magic-byte validation.
File deletion logic parses url_key and strips 'api/' prefix -- fragile if cover_url format ever changes. Store relative filename/path separately in DB for safer deletion.
Re-hashes password on every restart even when unchanged (new bcrypt salt each time). Harmless but wasteful; compare before updating.
FastAPI on_event is deprecated; migrate to lifespan context manager.
No pagination; to_list(500) hard cap could hide records once messages exceed 500.

action_items: Optional: add file size limits and stronger validation on /api/beats uploads (magic bytes, max MB).
Optional: migrate FastAPI startup/shutdown hooks to lifespan API.
Optional: store stored-filename separately from URL in beats doc for safer deletion.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is fine in size (~256 lines) but mixes models, auth, routes, seeding. Acceptable for MVP; split into modules if it grows.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} in all reads.
Env vars used correctly (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_USERNAME/PASSWORD); no hardcoded defaults that would mask missing config.
CORS allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' is unsafe in production; lock down CORS_ORIGINS when deploying.
JWT_SECRET in .env is a placeholder ('change-in-prod-2026'); fine for preview, rotate before production.
Content-type checks on uploads are client-controlled; trivially bypassable. OK for admin-only endpoint but note it.
test_credentials: Admin -> username: teba, password: TebaHouse2026! (stored in /app/memory/test_credentials.md, seeded from backend/.env).
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral beat + contact records prefixed with 'TEST_' and clean up the beat inside the test. A few TEST_ contact messages remain in db.contact_messages (no delete endpoint); harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Use /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py as the regression suite; run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Uploads are served under /api/uploads/covers/<id>.<ext> and /api/uploads/audio/<id>.<ext>. Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Next iteration likely frontend: verify navbar smooth-scroll, beats inline player, contact form submits to /api/contact, /admin login + upload flow using the same admin creds.
rca of the issue: No bugs found; nothing to RCA.
